tools.name: ping
tools.description: Check connectivity and return the server version. Example: call once when a session starts.

tools.name: get_wishlist
tools.description: List saved items as static snapshots (prices as of save time). Example: platform="amazon", limit=20.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Full snapshot of one saved item. Example: id from get_wishlist or search_saved.

tools.name: add_item
tools.description: Save a page as an item: a static snapshot, nothing is monitored afterwards. Send only values present on the page; price is optional (omit for videos and free content); og:image is fetched when image is omitted. Example: url, title="Sony WH-1000XM5", price=349, currency="NZD", platform="noelleeming".

tools.name: delete_item
tools.description: Soft-delete one or more items (restorable with restore_item). Example: id=["<uuid1>", "<uuid2>"].

tools.name: restore_item
tools.description: Bring soft-deleted items back. Example: id="<uuid>".

tools.name: search_saved
tools.description: Keyword search over saved items. Example: query="standing desk", limit=10.

tools.name: update_price
tools.description: Record a new current price on an item (manual correction; the old price is kept for comparison). Example: id, price=299.

tools.name: update_item
tools.description: Edit fields on one item, or the same fields on up to 20 items (batch: attributes replace instead of merge). Example: id, status="shortlisted", notes="best value so far".

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: Without id: all collections with item counts and totals. With id: that collection and its items; the other parameters filter and sort those items. Example: id="<uuid>", status="shortlisted", sort="price_asc".

tools.name: create_collection
tools.description: Create a collection (folder) for items, optionally with a budget. Example: name="PC build", budget=1500, budget_currency="NZD".

tools.name: add_to_collection
tools.description: Put an existing item into a collection. Example: collection_id, item_id.

tools.name: remove_from_collection
tools.description: Take items out of a collection; the items themselves are kept. Example: collection_id, item_ids=["<uuid>"].

tools.name: delete_collection
tools.description: Delete a collection; its items stay in the Grabblist. Example: id="<uuid>".

tools.name: update_collection
tools.description: Change the name, icon, color, description, budget or sharing of a collection; omitted fields stay as they are. is_public=true returns the public URL. Example: id, is_public=true.

tools.name: link_items
tools.description: Link two items with a relation: alternative, complement, upgrade (to_id replaces from_id), duplicate, same_seller. One pair via from_id/to_id/relation, or up to 20 via pairs. Example: from_id, to_id, relation="alternative".

tools.name: get_item_graph
tools.description: An item with every linked item and the relation type. Example: id="<uuid>".

tools.name: unlink_items
tools.description: Remove one relation between two items. Example: from_id, to_id, relation="duplicate".

tools.name: get_item_history
tools.description: Change events for an item: who changed what, when and why. Example: item_id, limit=10.

tools.name: get_collection_activity
tools.description: Recent additions, removals and edits in a collection. Example: collection_id.

tools.name: set_pinned_items
tools.description: Pin up to 3 "Top Picks" shown first on the collection share page. Example: collection_id, item_ids=["<a>", "<b>"].

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Message the Grabblist team: bug, parsing failure, feature request or feedback. Only when the user asks or agrees; show them the text first. Example: type="parsing_failure", tool="add_item", url, message="price not found".
